description: This file defines extensions and customizations for stock move and stock picking models in an Odoo module related to sales and inventory management, including methods for invoice creation, cancellation, and related data retrieval.

classes.name: stock_move
classes.description: Extension of stock.move with a sale order line reference.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Extension of stock.picking with sale order integration, invoice creation, and cancellation logic.

methods.name: get_currency_id
methods.description: Returns the currency ID from the related sale order if available.

methods.name: _get_payment_term
methods.description: Retrieves the payment term ID from the sale order.

methods.name: _get_address_invoice
methods.description: Gets invoice address details from the sale order.

methods.name: _get_comment_invoice
methods.description: Gets invoice comment from the sale or stock picking.

methods.name: _get_price_unit_invoice
methods.description: Determines unit price for invoice line based on sale order line.

methods.name: _get_discount_invoice
methods.description: Retrieves discount from sale order line.

methods.name: _get_taxes_invoice
methods.description: Gets applicable taxes from sale order line.

methods.name: _get_account_analytic_invoice
methods.description: Returns analytic account ID from sale order.

methods.name: _invoice_line_hook
methods.description: Hook to modify invoice lines, marks sale order line as invoiced.

methods.name: _invoice_hook
methods.description: Hook to modify invoice, links invoice to sale order.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Creates invoices for stock pickings, links sale order lines, and sets invoice details.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels stock pickings and triggers sale order shipment end if applicable.
